extracted.intended_audience: diabetes researchers, donors, and people affected by diabetes (patients/public)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance from a charitable funder (Diabetes UK) about what kinds of diabetes research they prioritise and how they approach funding, engagement, and impact. Intended to orient researchers and the public to the charity's research aims and values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-centred prioritisation
rubrics_metrics.description: Putting what matters most to people with diabetes at the top of the agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organisation explicitly states it funds and shapes research by listening to people with diabetes and prioritising work that aligns with their needs and concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact-focused funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver research that makes the biggest possible impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding choices are guided by potential for substantial, positive change in diabetes care and outcomes — projects should aim to produce significant, demonstrable benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translational emphasis on treatments and cures
rubrics_metrics.description: Support scientists who are pushing for the next treatment breakthrough and speeding up progress towards cures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference is signalled for work that advances treatments or curative approaches and accelerates development from research to clinical benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public involvement and contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Research requires public participation: every study participation, shared opinion, and donation contributes to progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The charity emphasises the importance of participation and input from people with diabetes and the wider public (patient and public involvement) in shaping and supporting research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority on filling urgent research gaps
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for projects that help fill the most urgent research gaps in diabetes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Researchers are invited to find information on grants and ways to join in addressing identified priority areas; funding is used to target pressing unanswered questions in the field.
